China's AI and Drone Advancements Raise US Concerns

Reports indicate China is making significant advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) and drone technology, prompting concerns in the United States. The Wall Street Journal highlights US apprehension over China potentially 'stealing' American AI through a process called 'distillation'. Meanwhile, the South China Morning Post reports on China's progress in integrating uncrewed land, sea, and air platforms, a complex drone-swarm technology. JD.com is also investing heavily in AI-driven automation, planning to deploy 3 million robots for logistics. Additionally, a proposed US ban on Chinese drones has raised concerns among American police and farmers who rely on the technology.
